text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Is it impossible after all?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The final jewel. At least, if nothing else...
If nothing else, I wanted to make it mine."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry... for not being the strong,
cool big sister you deserved..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...I really don't want this.
I want to win...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho... without fail!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos...
Getting revenge is pretty tough, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"...We still have the final race, the Shuka Sho, left!
Let's cheer her on!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos...
If it's you—"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos~~!!
You've gotta win the Shuka Sho no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Fan
text_block_list.text:
...For her sake, who fell just one step short in tears!
Please...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah,
I promise.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I have to win.
Without fail!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'm fine! A-And then?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho! What should we do to make sure we definitely win!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon returning, Vivlos quickly put aside
her frustration, a look of fierce determination
shining in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I know full well that no such thing exists, but...
Still, having come this far!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I want to live up to everyone's expectations.
The Shuka Sho... I will definitely win it!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'll do my best in training!
We're having a summer camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The summer training camp, aimed at improving the Umamusume's skills... That is where they grow so much they become almost unrecognizable.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Still, isn't that true for everyone?
So, one more thing!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I want confidence!
Just one more thing to win...!
choice_data_list: In that case, want to add another race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While training camp certainly brings growth, race sharpness tends to dull a bit. Therefore, to ensure we leave nothing to chance, we will run in a prep race for the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed,
it might put our minds at ease if we can race."
choice_data_list: Can you run while listening to your body?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aah!
Suddenly treating me like a total kid!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I know I'm a kid, but I'm not THAT much of a kid! So it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you'll be watching me,
won't you, Trainy?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Then you'll be fine! Let's run the Shion Stakes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And so, I'll definitely win the Shuka Sho...
and get my revenge!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next target race was decided to be
the Shion Stakes, right after the summer training camp.
